sar.narrative: This report details suspected card-not-present fraud involving customer C07987 and card C07987-K2. On 2016-12-01 at 17:28:53, an online transaction of $99.92 was attempted in billing region 264. The purchase was made using a device profile (Windows | other | chrome 61.0 | 1280x720) that was marked as new for this account. While the transaction amount was typical for the cardholder's history, the transaction model scored the event at 0.799. Graph analysis revealed that this rare device profile was used on two other cards (C06224-K2 and C11309-K1) belonging to two other customers between 2016-11-29 and 2016-12-01. One of those uses was also marked as a new device, and the transaction model scored two of those related transactions as highly suspicious. This shared use of a rare, fully specified device profile across multiple unrelated accounts strongly indicates a coordinated fraud ring. The total exposure for this case is $99.92. Consequently, the bank has blocked the card, created a case, and initiated monitoring on the connected cards.
